message.content:
This editorial illustration serves as a magazine cover. On the left, the massive head and upper torso of a dark, muscular bull with prominent horns and a ring through its nose lean into the frame, facing right. Its skin is textured with folds and highlights. On the right, a person wearing a red head covering and a tan, collared long-sleeve shirt and dark pants stands in a dynamic, leaning posture. This person holds a long-handled broom upright in their right hand, while their left hand grips a red-upholstered, ornate wooden chair. This person is much smaller in scale than the bull's head. The background is a pale, hazy beige and light blue, suggesting a dusty open space. 

The top of the image features the bold white text "TEMPO" against a blue-to-red gradient. Above it are three headlines: "INVESTIGASI: MARZUKI ALIE DI TVRI", "TIPU-TIPU BAHAN MENTAH FREEPORT", and "KUHAP BARU DAN PELEMAHAN KPK". Below the title is the date "17-23 FEBRUARI 2014" and the hashtag "#SaveRisma" in black and red. Additional text reads: "Menolak proyek jalan tol, Wali Kota Surabaya itu dipasangkan dengan wakil yang tidak sehaluan. Ditanduk banteng lokal." In the bottom right, there is a price of "RP 33.000", a URL, "MAJALAH BERITA MINGGUAN", an ISSN number, and a barcode.
